entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Network-aware migration channel resolution for `dotnetup` #54931
  • ItShouldDetectFileWithMarkOfTheWeb: Expected boolean to be True, but found False #54928
  • System.ArgumentException: Cannot delete a subkey tree because the subkey does not exist #54927
  • Separate core `dotnetup` `record` classes #54926
  • Analyzer to catch multiple enumerations of `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` (like CA1851) #54925
  • dotnetup: SDK install fails with SSL error during release manifest fetch #54923
  • One process not started with aspire integ test #54921
  • Build Errors from Publish NativeAOT Size Analysis step #54919
  • $(RunCommand) quoting #54917
  • When using `dotnetup sdk uninstall` to uninstall the daily SDK, the preview SDK is removed instead of the daily SDK. #54916
  • dotnet watch crashes with a FormatException when editing a scoped CSS file #54915

Closed

  • [Deduplicate SDK Files] Release infra changes for Windows tarballs #52202
  • [Deduplicate SDK Files] Links on .NET downloads page? #52215
